multiplechoiceresponse.p: A wireless network on 2.4 GHz is slow and intermittent in a busy office. The best first change is to:

choice.div: Move clients to 5 GHz and use non-overlapping channels.
Increase the access point transmit power to maximum.

div.p: 2.4 GHz is congested and has few non-overlapping channels. 5 GHz offers more channels and less interference. Maximum power can worsen co-channel issues.

multiplechoiceresponse.p: A port that carries several VLANs between two switches is called:

div.p: Trunk ports tag frames with a VLAN id so multiple VLANs share one link. Access ports belong to a single VLAN.

choice.div: Forward packets between networks using its routing table.
Forward frames between ports in one VLAN.

div.p: Routers move packets between networks; switches move frames within one; DHCP servers assign addresses.
